title: The King's Hit List, Part 5
description: The King's Hit List, Part 5 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ghostly Guard

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 4 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Record Producer in the Mutanous Malaise, collect the Proof of Pwnage, sabotage the Recording Equipment and report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ghostly Guard

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 6

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 4 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Record Producer in the Mutanous Malaise, collect the Proof of Pwnage, sabotage the Recording Equipment and report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Offer:

I got word that you would be coming. The good thing about no one noticing my presence is that I hear all kinds of interesting gossip. Did you know that Vergrim is actually scared of particle effects? Yeah, totally afraid of particle effects and every time he casts a spell he nearly breaks into tears.

Anyway, I hear you are looking for information on the happenings in the Shadow's Embrace. Well, I might be able to help you then. You see, a Guild of Shadows creature showed up not long ago under the guise of helping Rotgut's new record label pump out some hit records. You would be helping me alot if you could take them out and in return I will listen around for any information about the Shadow's Embrace.

I hear that the Guild of Shadows Record Producer is hiding out in Level 4 of Mutanous Malaise. There is a shortcut if you go to Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace and find the Guild of Shadow Teleporter. It will take you straight there and provide you with a clean getaway when you are through. Go in, take out the Guild of Shadows Record Producer and get the Proof of Pwnage, and sabotage the Recording Equipment. I will gather some intel for you and send a report to Sir Ving N'Seacressy, so he should have it when you report back to him in the Shadow Gate.

Turn-in:

I don't know you, and I've never seen you before, but did you take care of that thing we talked about?

Objectives:

  • Use Guild Teleporter on Level 4 ×1
  • Kill the Guild of Shadows Record Producer
  • Collect the Proof of Pwnage ×1
  • Sabotage the Recording Equipment ×1

Level range: 45–100
